429b.name: PAUSE
429b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits for the RTCLOK low byte $14 to change once per requested tick.

503d.name: TRIGGER@
503d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Reads GTIA trigger register $D010 plus controller index and masks bit zero.

3f58.name: WORD-COUNT
3f58.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Returns address+2 and the 16-bit length stored at address.

47cd.name: RESOURCE-BASE
47cd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Startup selects $A050 for introduction resources and $A3E0 for gameplay resources.

5eb2.name: DISABLE-DISPLAY-DMA
5eb2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Saves SDMCTL ($022F) and writes zero there.

5ece.name: RESTORE-DISPLAY-DMA
5ece.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores SDMCTL ($022F) from the saved variable.

5f26.name: PLAY-MUSIC
5f26.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores selected tune then calls native sound-player entry $3003 with A=0 and X=tune.

5f3a.name: STOP-MUSIC
5f3a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Calls native sound-player entry $3003 with command A=$40.

6acb.name: GET-GAME-INPUT
6acb.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Sets an input-mode flag, invokes input/pointer polling, normalizes the result, clears the flag and returns it.

6b74.name: EXECUTE-GAME-ACTION
6b74.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects an action PFA from a variable, converts to CFA and executes it.

74db.name: GAME-LOOP
74db.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Initializes interface and action state, then repeatedly obtains input and executes game actions until the exit flag is set.

8432.name: DICTIONARY-MARK
8432.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Two saved cells contain HERE and LATEST for dictionary restoration.

843d.name: SAVE-DICTIONARY-MARK
843d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Stores HERE and LATEST in the two cells at CFA8432.

8454.name: RESTORE-DICTIONARY
8454.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Restores DP and the cold-start DP/FENCE/latest cells from the dictionary mark.

84e2.name: TITLE-SKIP-FLAG
84e2.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Boolean flag set after controller-zero trigger is pressed.

84ec.name: POLL-TITLE-SKIP
84ec.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Tests trigger zero and sets title-skip flag on first press; stops the music.

8517.name: WAIT-TITLE
8517.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Waits a specified number of frame ticks while polling trigger zero; exits early on title-skip flag.

853a.name: INIT-TITLE-DISPLAY
853a.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Disables DMA, loads/installs intro display and character resources, initializes music and VBI; prints ERROR on failed load.

8637.name: PRINT-CENTERED-TEXT
8637.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Centers a word-counted string in a 40-column line and calls STYPE.

865d.name: SCREEN-ROW-ADDR
865d.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Multiplies row by 40 and adds the OS screen pointer at $58.

8675.name: COPY-TEXT-ROW
8675.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Copies 40 bytes from the temporary line buffer into the requested screen row.

868b.name: CLEAR-TEXT-ROW
868b.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Erases 40 bytes at the requested screen row.

869e.name: RENDER-CENTERED-ROW
869e.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Temporarily switches the OS screen pointer to a 40-byte buffer, renders centered text, then restores it.

86cd.name: SCROLL-EIGHT-PIXELS
86cd.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Writes 0,2,4,6 into ANTIC VSCROL ($D405), pausing one tick between values.

86ef.name: SCROLL-TITLE-ROW
86ef.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Moves the prepared row through screen lines with vertical fine scrolling, polling for the skip trigger.

8763.name: SCROLL-TITLE-TEXT
8763.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Looks up consecutive packed lines, centers them in the temporary buffer and scrolls each into the title area.

8783.name: SHOW-TITLE-PAGE
8783.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Scrolls the lines of one packed title page and waits 150 frame ticks.

87a0.name: SHOW-TITLE-SEQUENCE
87a0.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Loops over eight intro text pages until trigger zero is pressed, then changes music and presents the final page.

87e7.name: BOOT-INTRO
87e7.evidence: Inferred descriptive name, not recovered original: Selects intro resources, initializes the title, restores dictionary state, shows intro pages, selects gameplay resources and enters GAME-LOOP.

3e60.name: RUN-VBI1
3e60.evidence: Matches GAM FORTH deferred-VBI native routine: SETVBV with X/Y selecting vector $3E18.

3e7d.name: STOP-VBI1
3e7d.evidence: Matches GAM FORTH deferred-VBI native routine: SETVBV with X/Y selecting vector $E462.
